object_description: elongated two-storey slab projecting towards the lake
design_condition: the long volume follows the street on a gently sloping moraine slope and generates a square-like outdoor space between the existing buildings

positive: Generates a square-like, connecting outdoor space between the existing buildings
Transparent ground floor signals the function as main building and enlivens the public space
Entrance clearly marked by an offset in the glass facade
Two-storey foyer gives an overview of the spatial structure and opens to the green space
Low height respects the presence of the neighbouring primary school
Integrating garage exit, bicycle room and break hall into the main volume strengthens the urban proposal
Skeleton structure allows great flexibility for future changes of use
Compact and efficient volume with floor area, volume and cost in the medium range
Very convincing urban design, clear and reduced structure
negative: Covered playground is a third too small
Inner course rooms have no direct connection to the outside
Several spatial relationships are not optimally solved (utility rooms separated from the kitchen, difficult MDZ layout)
Vertical offset of the south-facing column grid needs optimisation
Wet room cores do not overlap between floors
Operational shortcomings need to be optimised
